Explain it once — inside the website

How QR, commission and bonus work.

Commission policy Real examples Partner Terms summary

Instead of asking GoVietStay in chat every time, partners can study the earning logic here: what the QR does, when a booking becomes eligible, how commission is credited and how a performance bonus can be added.

🔳

1) How the QR works

Each QR contains a tracked GoVietStay link created from the Partner ID. When the traveler scans it, the guest first enters GoVietStay — not directly a random chat — so attribution can be recorded.

QR → LandingPartner IDTracked
💸

2) How commission works

Commission is not created by a click alone. It appears only when the booking is eligible according to Product Master and Partner Terms: valid attribution, completed booking, correct channel, correct product rules and no fraud flags.

Eligible bookingCore rulesAnti-fraud
📈

3) How bonus works

Bonus is an extra performance layer. It should be calculated only from approved rules published by GoVietStay — for example, a volume bonus after a defined number of eligible completed bookings in a period.

Performance bonusMonthly / campaign based

Partner Terms — quick summary

The rules a partner should understand before starting.

1. AttributionOnly valid tracked attribution recognized by GoVietStay Core can create an eligible partner booking.
2. CompletionClicks and leads alone do not create commission. The applicable booking must satisfy the active completion rule.
3. Approved pricing & offersPartners must not invent prices, discounts, inclusions or cancellation promises.
4. Anti-fraudDuplicate accounts, self-referrals, manipulated attribution and coupon abuse may be rejected.
5. PayoutPayout timing and method follow the current Partner Terms and verification requirements.
6. Independent partnerPublic affiliate participation does not automatically create an employment relationship or guaranteed salary.
Language rule
EN mode should show English UI and explanations. RU mode should show Russian UI and explanations. Brand names, destination names and product names may remain proper nouns where appropriate.

Traveler FAQ

SUPPORT

Children, weather, pickup, meals, cancellation, return time, what to bring and special requests.

Never guess on price, safety, visa or cancellation rules.
Partner Support

If the traveler asks something important, do not guess.

Ask GoVietStay

The support button in production should use the admin-configured contact and automatically include Partner ID, selected tour and booking context.

Escalation rule

If an answer can change price, safety, cancellation, visa/immigration requirements or tour conditions, the partner should contact GoVietStay instead of improvising.
Technology moat

The interface can be copied. The engine should not be.

A public webpage cannot be made truly uncopyable. The defensible advantage should live in server-side logic, proprietary data, partner network and operations.

🔐

Signed referral tokens

Changing visible URL parameters should not create valid attribution.

🧠

Server-only rules

Commission, eligibility, attribution window, payout and discount logic stay out of browser JavaScript.

🕸️

Partner-traveler data graph

Clicks, campaigns, leads, repeat travelers and bookings create proprietary learning.

🛡️

Anti-fraud

Duplicate accounts, self-referrals, coupon abuse and suspicious traffic are reviewed before crediting.

⚙️

Product Master

Active tours, URLs, languages, official price, status and allowed rules come from Core.

🚀

Network advantage

Partners, content, reviews, conversion data and local operations are harder to copy than a design.

Legal-safe product design

Clear rules protect the traveler, partner and GoVietStay.

🤝

Partner status

Affiliate / referral participation should be separated from employee salary unless a separate employment relationship exists.

📢

Advertising disclosure

Creators should clearly disclose commercial relationships when required and use approved prices, facts and claims.

🔏

Personal data

Collect only necessary data, publish a Privacy Notice, record consent and define retention/deletion rules.

🧾

Travel & e-commerce

Service, booking, payment, cancellation and GoVietStay's role should be accurately disclosed; final legal text must match the actual entity, licenses and payment model.
